name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Onboarding & Implementation | Multi-Implementation Project Management, Training, Go-Live | SMB Retail SaaS
summary: Customer onboarding and implementation specialist with 15+ years in SaaS, including two years onboarding 25+ small-business clients a month at Wix (~25 concurrent at peak) at 110% of implementation targets. Owns the customer from signed contract to go-live: project plans, configuration, training, troubleshooting, and the proactive updates that keep customers from ever chasing a status. Brings a retail owner's view of operations from co-owning a licensed, regulated retail business in Denver, and the technical aptitude to configure platforms, integrations, and workflows hands-on. Comfortable with travel, evenings, and weekends when a go-live needs it.
